reviews.builderContext: /root — frozen Reach candidate ad086446 on protected base 5e72620c; builder rationale excluded from bounded packet.
reviews.reviewerContext: /root/reach_render_review — separate read-only reviewer; fresh renders inspected before Reach source comparison or historical verdict consultation. Same independent context retains prior repair/diagnostic history.

composition.observation: The 1440x900 instrument gives the pointing plane most of the width and places registered preview, readiness and next action together to its right. At 390x844, acquisition guidance moves above the plane and the active controls sit immediately below it. This supports the current target without requiring the phone user to search another screen for progress.

hierarchy.observation: Cream stage headings, brass primary actions and mint readiness distinguish instructions from the interactive plane. FIT_READY explicitly requires an independent check and shows unmeasured outcomes; passed results then expose practice. On the phone the compact current-target message is prioritized over the secondary camera preview.

typography.observation: Serif headings and plain sans-serif instructions follow the accepted Homeport shell. Target numbers, progress percentages and check labels remain readable in the inspected desktop and phone viewports; the smaller monospaced instrument labels carry secondary context rather than the sole action instruction. No essential text collision was observed in active calibration or check controls.

spacing.observation: Desktop stage groups have clear separation, with metrics divided by rules and recovery actions grouped below acquisition. Phone target guidance, plane and two-row buttons fit the viewport in the observed active states. The separate returned Devices doorway remains flush to the page edge and briefly clips beneath the sticky header in one phone recording; this is retained as minor polish.

controls.observation: Visible actions name the current stage: Pause calibration and Resume calibration become Pause check and Cancel check for independent validation. Retry stays beside the target action. Playground offers practice, pause and recalibrate with an explicit no-activation explanation. Two-hand selection and camera retry/demo controls are operable in the observed journey; closed diagnostics and every hidden management control are not claimed visually verified.

contrast.observation: The dark instrument uses high-contrast cream action text, distinct brass primary buttons, mint readiness and an outlined amber provisional pointer. The pointer is also explained in text, and detected-but-ineligible state gives a concrete framing instruction. The current capture records no serious Axe issues across its observed states; this supplements, rather than replaces, the rendered contrast judgment.

consistency.observation: Desktop and mobile retain the Voyagewright account/navigation shell, cream headings and brass/mint instrument vocabulary of the accepted Homeport references. Absolute and relative stages use the same acquisition and held-out-check structure while labeling their distinct estimate claims. Controls and recovery wording remain consistent across normal/reduced-motion recordings.

states.observation: Fresh renders distinguish welcome consent, disclosed demo tracking, active and paused acquisition, FIT_READY awaiting five held-out targets, independent results and safe practice. Multiple detected hands expose an explicit active choice; detected ineligible framing retains the count but hides the usable pointer. Camera-unavailable offers retry or disclosed demo. Both modes reach their own results and return in all twelve recordings.

responsive.observation: Fresh stills are genuine fixed viewports: 1440x900 desktop and 390x844 mobile. Phone training and validation keep progress beside the target and render the main stage buttons without horizontal overflow. Inspected recordings show scrolled demo condition controls and the privacy/safety footer in the absolute journey. Phone result metric rows, closed diagnostics and other regions never shown are outside this visual claim; recordings are not full-document proof.

keyboard.observation: All twelve trace action streams contain Tab navigation and Enter activation through the actual application, with arrow/Home keys for absolute demo controls. The resulting recordings reach setup, held-out results, practice and return without pointer automation replacing those actions. This proves the captured keyboard journey, not exhaustive screen-reader behavior or every hidden control.

focus.observation: The rendered resume action has a conspicuous double brass/mint outline, the active pointing plane has a visible boundary, and the tracking-condition select visibly retains keyboard focus. Phone check controls remain in the visible task group. Trace focus checks and successful keyboard transitions support the observed focus behavior; the returned doorway clipping is retained separately and not generalized to all controls.

feedback.observation: Acquisition percentage and target count change beside the target in phone recordings; paused state explains that completed targets are saved. FIT_READY explicitly says independent check required, and validation identifies the provisional pointer and unchanged fit. Camera waiting/error and detected-but-ineligible framing give distinct feedback. A secondary Target saved message can still linger while the next target is collecting; the primary target/count/percentage are correct, so this remains minor polish.

motion.observation: The normal and reduced-motion recordings complete the same task outcomes and recovery paths on both viewports without requiring an animated cue. No disruptive motion or state-loss event appeared in the inspected transitions. Captured activation-to-rendered-readiness measurements range from 840.105 to 876.847 ms within the 5000 ms contract budget; this is software UI feedback, not camera exposure, inference latency or physical pointing accuracy.

continuity.observation: The visible Devices doorway enters Reach without pairing or implicit camera activation, and all twelve recordings return to Devices with the Voyagewright shell and account access intact. Captured continuity hashes remain identical at outcomes and return. The flush-left doorway and one brief phone header clipping are nonblocking visual issues, not evidence that the return destination or account context was lost.

complexity.observation: The experience advances one target at a time, then asks for five new targets instead of exposing model internals as a user task. Demo controls are explicitly disclosed and secondary; diagnostics/privacy are collapsed. Absolute and relative choices explain separate outcomes, and the playground explains that nothing activates. Results on phone are a longer scroll; only the regions actually shown in the packet are visually endorsed.

role-outcomes.observation: For the contracted anonymous role, the packet demonstrates entering from Devices, explicitly selecting a camera attempt or labeled simulation, distinguishing detected hands from usable posture, calibrating absolute or relative movement, independently checking new targets, practicing safely and returning. The relative result is cursor error and does not establish absolute-screen pointing. Current captures are D0 simulation/fallback software proof; historical photographic D1 and physical D4 remain separately identified.

fallbacks.observation: All four camera-failure recordings show an explicit camera-unavailable message with retry and Try the demo, then a disclosed simulated hand and successful return. Phone waiting-for-permission does not claim a detected ready hand. Invalid framing preserves the detected-hand count but gives a concrete recenter instruction and no usable pointer; multiple-hand practice provides explicit active selection. Physical denial/recovery on a real device is not established by these controlled software journeys.

findings.observation: The initial phone experience put live acquisition progress away from the active target, obstructing simultaneous aim and feedback.
findings.resolution: Fresh 390x844 absolute and relative recordings show current-target guidance, counts and acquisition percentage immediately above the plane, with relevant controls immediately below. Target progression and held-out checking remain visible.

findings.observation: Initial independent validation reused calibration action labels, weakening the separation between training and held-out measurement.
findings.resolution: Fresh independent check renders Pause check and Cancel check, labels its amber pointer provisional, and explicitly states that new targets do not change the fit. FIT_READY requires five new targets before results/practice.

findings.observation: Initial photographic replay exposed contradictory permission/provider-readiness wording alongside a detected eligible hand.
findings.resolution: Fresh controlled camera waiting/error states are distinct from ready simulated tracking. The original photographic D1 repair evidence remains historical at source 632e1895; a bounded Reach/projection source comparison to ad086446 found no changed files. This preserves that repaired D1 observation without presenting it as a newly captured webcam result.

findings.observation: Initial evidence lacked meaningful recordings for relative flow, motion variants, paused acquisition and return.
findings.resolution: The current authenticated packet supplies all twelve device/motion/journey recordings. This reviewer inspected meaningful transition frames from each and checked all twelve trace action streams. Current evidence now shows both modes, pause/resume, camera fallback and returns; unshown below-fold regions remain an explicit limit.

findings.observation: Initial enlarged full-page images could not reliably establish live viewport obstruction or actual active-plane visibility.
findings.resolution: The fresh 84 stills have verified device viewport dimensions and all 84 trace screenshot calls use fullPage:false. Inspected recordings show the active plane, task controls and actually scrolled demo/footer regions without the old capture-induced invalidation. This is sufficient bounded task evidence, not equivalent full-document coverage; unseen regions are excluded.

findings.observation: An earlier passed-result plane retained acquisition/hold instructions after the measurement was complete.
findings.resolution: Fresh FIT_READY/results planes instead explain that the setup remains local to this pointing area; acquisition-specific holds remain in training/check stages.

findings.observation: The Devices doorway link remains flush-left outside the centered pairing card. At roughly 43.68 s in the mobile NORMAL absolute recording, its text briefly clips beneath the sticky navigation after return.
findings.resolution: Retained nonblocking: the route completes and the link is readable in the returned desktop still and other phone returns. A future spacing/scroll-position polish can place the doorway consistently within the visible content gutter.
findings.recommendedScope: Devices doorway spacing and returned scroll alignment; no current product repair requested.

findings.observation: At roughly 16 s in the desktop NORMAL absolute recording, the secondary Target saved wording persists while target 5 is collecting 53%; the main target count and percentage are correct.
findings.resolution: Retained nonblocking: make the secondary save acknowledgement expire or identify the completed target if later polished. The current acquisition remains understandable from the primary target and progress.
findings.recommendedScope: Acquisition secondary acknowledgement wording only; no current product repair requested.

findings.observation: The retained local 4x CPU diagnostic at frozen 12f51f9c confirmed a production-page transient 1x1 during fullPage screenshot, followed by size-triggered PREPARE reset and loss of the held-out-check action. Two hosted ordinary attempts failed action waits; their exact causal attribution remains unproved.
findings.resolution: Resolved for current capture/replay scope by the separately owner-authorized and independently reviewed PR 720 infrastructure predecessor, landed 5e72620c. It captures actual fixed viewports and has a genuine-resize invalidation positive control; Reach geometry/context guards and semantic, keyboard, Axe and journey requirements remain intact. Fresh current recordings now complete FIT_READY to held-out check, results and playground in both modes/devices/motion settings. This is fresh software evidence, not a retrospective proof of the hosted failure cause or a fourth Reach product repair.
findings.blockingScope: Historical trusted capture/replay interaction; current bounded software capture resolved.

reviews.acceptanceScope: Source-bound bounded Reach Phase1 software experience for the captured anonymous desktop/mobile normal/reduced-motion matrix; no unresolved blocker in that evidence scope. Ordinary protected qualification, physical readiness and owner acceptance remain separate.

provenance.repairCampaignDisposition: Three Reach product repairs preserved. Provenance reconciliation and owner-approved separately qualified PR 720 are not a fourth product repair or counter reset.

limitations: Viewport stills cover only the actually captured scrolled viewport. They are not equivalent to full-page images.

Recordings prove only regions actually shown. Inspected absolute recordings show lower demo conditions and privacy/safety footer; phone result metric rows, closed diagnostics and unshown controls are not fully visually verified.
Recording review sampled meaningful transitions and targeted states, not every encoded frame. Trace actions supplement visual inspection without proving unshown appearance.

Current controlled journeys are D0 simulation and camera-unavailability software evidence. Original photographic D1 remains identified at 632e1895; neither proves physical D4 webcam pointing accuracy.
Feedback timing is rendered software response, not camera/inference/physical accuracy. Relative cursor control is a separate claim from absolute pointing.
Anonymous-role Chromium desktop/mobile viewport evidence does not establish real touch feel, all assistive technologies, every browser/device or long-duration field behavior.
Historical hosted ordinary failures remain retained FAIL records. Exact failure causation is an inference despite confirmed local full-page mechanism and fresh successful viewport capture.
This accepted independent review does not itself confer ordinary protected qualification, production readiness or human owner acceptance. Owner acceptance is NOT_CLAIMED.
